PerkDescription.DefaultText: Boosts testosterone levels and confers the ability to impregnate.
Increases assertiveness and male physical traits such as body hair, larger stature and greater muscle mass.
Feels comfortable with most tasks, but sacrifices some creativity and stresses more easily.
Likes performing methodical tasks, such as weaving, grinding or fleshing.
Likes performing physical tasks, such as felling trees, chopping wood or smithing.
Decreases size and combat reach, decreases caloric needs and enhances stealth capabilities.
